hooks.name: preload-block-fresh-on-index-save
hooks.description: When index.html is saved, check that the generated preload block still matches the picture list (exit 3 = stale).

action.command: mkdir -p docs/kiro_evidence/raw && echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) hook fired: index.html saved" >> docs/kiro_evidence/raw/hook_runs.log ; python3 -B scripts/make_preload_links.py >> docs/kiro_evidence/raw/hook_runs.log 2>&1 ; true
